title: Step 4a - Linear Regression: Plotting Real vs Predicted Salaries Visualization

cues.en: -: All right, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友。

cues.en: Are you ready for the final steps of this implementation?
cues.zh: 準備好實作最後幾步了嗎？

cues.en: First, we're going to visualize the training set results and second, we will visualize the test set results.
cues.zh: 先把訓練集結果視覺化，再把測試集結果視覺化。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's start by creating a new code cell.
cues.zh: 先建立新的程式儲存格。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Now we just want to plot on a nice graphic, the real salaries compared to the predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 我們要在一張清楚的圖中，比較實際薪資與預測薪資。

cues.en: So basically we're gonna have a 2D plot with the X axis being the numbers of years of experience, you know, from one to 10, and the Y axis being the salaries,
cues.zh: 基本上是一張二維圖，x 軸是工作年資，大約從 1 到 10 年，y 軸是薪資，

cues.en: you know, in the range of salaries given in this dataset.
cues.zh: 範圍依資料集中的薪資而定。

cues.en: And so we will plot in red points, the real salaries and in a blue straight line, the predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 用紅點表示實際薪資，藍色直線表示預測薪資。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And we will do that both for the predictions in the training set and the predictions in a test set.
cues.zh: 訓練集與測試集的預測，都會用這種方式呈現。

cues.en: Are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們開始。

cues.en: We're gonna first call Matplotlib.
cues.zh: 先呼叫 Matplotlib。

cues.en: As a reminder, it has the shortcut, PLT, actually what we're gonna call is, exactly the pie plot module from the Matplotlib library.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，簡稱 plt 實際上代表 Matplotlib 函式庫的 pyplot 模組。

cues.en: And this is what is having the PLT shortcut.
cues.zh: 也就是設定 plt 簡稱的那個模組。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Let's start by calling pie plot, PLT.
cues.zh: 先呼叫 pyplot，也就是 plt。

cues.en: And then we're gonna call a specific function from this module, which is called scatter.
cues.zh: 再呼叫模組中的 scatter 函式。

cues.en: And scatter will allow us to put the red points, you know, corresponding to the real salaries in the 2D plots, okay?
cues.zh: scatter 可以在二維圖上畫出代表實際薪資的紅點。

cues.en: So naturally what we have to input here are, the coordinates of these red points, representing the real salaries.
cues.zh: 所以要傳入這些紅點，也就是實際薪資的座標。

cues.en: And these coordinates are nothing else than X train and Y train, right?
cues.zh: 座標就是 X_train 與 y_train。

cues.en: Because remember, the X axis will be the numbers of years of experience.
cues.zh: 因為 x 軸是工作年資。

cues.en: That's what is contained in X train.
cues.zh: 它就在 X_train 裡。

cues.en: And the Y axis will be the salaries and that is what is contained in Y train.
cues.zh: y 軸是薪資，存在 y_train。

cues.en: So here, in this scatter here, we just have to input the coordinate First, X train for the numbers of years of experience.
cues.zh: 因此 scatter 的第一個引數是 X_train，代表工作年資。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And then, Y train for the salaries.
cues.zh: 第二個是 y_train，代表薪資。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then we can add another argument, which is color and which will allow us to choose color of these points.
cues.zh: 再加一個 color 引數，選擇點的顏色。

cues.en: And as we said, we're gonna choose red, perfect.
cues.zh: 如前所述，選 red。

cues.en: Then, next step is to plot the regression line.
cues.zh: 接著畫迴歸線。

cues.en: So remember from the intuition lectures, the regression line is the line of the predictions, coming as close as possible to the real results,
cues.zh: 概念課介紹過，迴歸線代表預測結果，盡量貼近真實結果，

cues.en: you know, to the real salaries.
cues.zh: 也就是實際薪資。

cues.en: And therefore the predictions, you know, the points corresponding to the predicted salaries, will follow a straight line, right?
cues.zh: 所以對應預測薪資的點，會沿著一條直線排列。

cues.en: As in a linear function.
cues.zh: 就像線性函數。

cues.en: And therefore here we're not gonna use the scatter method, we're gonna use the plot method Cause that's what we use to plot the curve of a function.
cues.zh: 這裡不用 scatter，而是 plot，因為它用來畫函數的曲線。

cues.en: And since our function is linear, it'll actually be a straight line.
cues.zh: 我們的函數是線性的，所以畫出來就是直線。

cues.en: All right, so there we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's call first, the PLT module, pie plot.
cues.zh: 先呼叫 plt，也就是 pyplot 模組。

cues.en: Then from this module we're gonna call the plot function.
cues.zh: 再呼叫 plot 函式。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And in this function, while same, as in the scatter function, we have to input the coordinates of the points or line nodes corresponding to the predictions.
cues.zh: 和 scatter 一樣，這裡要傳入預測點或線上節點的座標。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們來做。

cues.en: According to you what is the first coordinate of these predicted salaries?
cues.zh: 你認為預測薪資的第一個座標是什麼？

cues.en: Well, that's of course X train, why is that?
cues.zh: 當然是 X_train，為什麼？

cues.en: It's because right now we're visualizing the results of the training set.
cues.zh: 因為現在畫的是訓練集結果。

cues.en: Okay, so these corresponds to the numbers of years of experience of the employees in the training set.
cues.zh: 所以對應訓練集中員工的工作年資。

cues.en: That's the X coordinate.
cues.zh: 這是 x 座標。

cues.en: Okay, now we're gonna input the Y coordinate.
cues.zh: 接著傳入 y 座標。

cues.en: And according to you, which ones are these?
cues.zh: 你認為應該是什麼？

cues.en: Well, it's something we haven't created yet.
cues.zh: 其實這是還沒建立的資料。

cues.en: You know, we created actually the y_pred variable containing the predicted salaries of the test set, but we haven't created a vector containing the predicted salaries of the training set.
cues.zh: 我們建立過 y_pred，包含測試集的預測薪資，但還沒有建立訓練集預測薪資的向量。

cues.en: And that's totally fine.
cues.zh: 沒有關係。

cues.en: What we will actually enter here as the Y coordinate of this plot we're about to make, are gonna be exactly the predicted salaries of the training set.
cues.zh: 這裡要傳入的 y 座標，正是訓練集的預測薪資。

cues.en: And to get them I'm going to copy this and paste that right here.
cues.zh: 要取得它們，就複製這段，貼到這裡。

cues.en: But instead of inputting here X test, I'm going to input actually X train.
cues.zh: 但不再傳 X_test，而是 X_train。

cues.en: Because calling the predict method on X train, meaning on the numbers of years of experience of the employees in the training set, will get me exactly the predicted salaries
cues.zh: 因為對 X_train，也就是訓練集員工的年資呼叫 predict，就能得到

cues.en: of the training set.
cues.zh: 訓練集的預測薪資。

cues.en: All right, just as before with predict X test.
cues.zh: 和前面的 predict(X_test) 一樣。

cues.en: So X train, yes?
cues.zh: 所以這裡用 X_train。

cues.en: And then just as before, we're gonna choose a color which this time will be blue, right?
cues.zh: 再像剛才一樣選顏色，這次是 blue。

cues.en: So that we can clearly see the difference between the real salaries and the predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 方便清楚區別實際薪資與預測薪資。

cues.en: Okay, so this will plot the regression line.
cues.zh: 這樣就會畫出迴歸線。

cues.en: Now, next step, what can we do?
cues.zh: 下一步還能做什麼？

cues.en: So here we're gonna add a title.
cues.zh: 加入標題。

cues.en: And to do this we have to call the title function.
cues.zh: 使用 title 函式。

cues.en: And inside in the parenthesis, we just have to input in quotes, well, the title we want for our graph.
cues.zh: 在括號中，用引號填入想要的圖表標題。

cues.en: And so let's say salary versus experience, okay?
cues.zh: 例如 Salary vs Experience。

cues.en: You can choose any other title if you prefer another one.
cues.zh: 也可以換成喜歡的標題。

cues.en: So salary versus experience.
cues.zh: 就寫 Salary vs Experience。

cues.en: And then we're gonna specify the training set because indeed, then we'll do the same for the test set.
cues.zh: 再標明 Training set，因為之後還會畫測試集。

cues.en: Now we're just gonna add a label to the X axis and to the Y axis.
cues.zh: 接著替 x 軸與 y 軸加標籤。

cues.en: And for this we have to use the xlabel function into which we have to input, well, the label we want to display on the X axis.
cues.zh: 使用 xlabel，傳入想顯示的 x 軸文字。

cues.en: And we're gonna choose in quote, of course, years of experience.
cues.zh: 當然，填入引號中的 Years of Experience。

cues.en: All right, good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now we're gonna copy this because we're gonna do the same for the Y axis.
cues.zh: 再複製這段，替 y 軸做同樣的事。

cues.en: And the name of the function for this is Y Label.
cues.zh: 函式名稱是 ylabel。

cues.en: And for the Y label, well we'll choose to display salary.
cues.zh: y 軸標籤設為 Salary。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And finally, in order to show the graphic, well we just had to finish here with plt.show, you know, the show function.
cues.zh: 最後，寫 plt.show()，呼叫 show 函式來顯示圖表。

cues.en: And this will display the graphic in the output.
cues.zh: 這樣就會在輸出區呈現圖形。
